references.text: People ask Jesus about Elijah, reflecting the expectation of Elijah's return before the Messiah, as prophesied in Malachi.
The prophecy in Malachi about Elijah's return, which people associated with John the Baptist or one of the prophets.
A parallel event where people identify Jesus with John the Baptist, Elijah, or one of the prophets.
Jesus explains that Elijah has already come in the form of John the Baptist, linking to the people's speculation in Mark 8:28.
The people's expectation of the return of the prophets is reflected in the question about Jesus' identity, compared with Moses and Elijah at the Transfiguration.
People ask John the Baptist if he is the Christ, Elijah, or the Prophet, mirroring the question in Mark 8:28.
